$description: Which native libraries carry each component. React (@kinetixui/ui) ships every component; the four-platform rule (/docs/contributing) means every *new* component lands on SwiftUI, Jetpack Compose and Flutter too — so `exceptions` only records the standing exceptions. A slug absent from `exceptions` is on all four platforms. Re-derive this list by diffing component slugs against the native package sources: packages/ui-compose/ui/src/main/kotlin/com/kinetixui/ui/*.kt (PascalCase), packages/ui-swiftui/Sources/KinetixUI/*.swift (PascalCase), packages/ui-flutter/lib/src/*.dart (snake_case) — `sonner` resolves to Sonner/Toaster/toaster. Single source of truth, consumed by apps/web/src/lib/platform-parity.ts (web app) and scripts/gen-registry.mjs (CLI registry) — edit this file, not either of those.

notes.chart: no Recharts equivalent wired for Compose yet
notes.avatar-group: standing non-port — re-wraps its children, not idiomatic on native platforms; compose an Avatar row directly
notes.native-select: standing non-port — KinetixSelect already wraps each platform's own native picker
notes.tour: standing non-port — targeting an arbitrary already-rendered element needs a CSS-selector-equivalent live-tree query, which no native platform has
notes.kanban-board: standing non-port — built on @dnd-kit; each native platform would need its own from-scratch accessible multi-container drag-and-drop implementation (no equivalent dependency exists in this repo's native packages)
